title: Japanese Chicken Donburi
description: A classic Japanese dish made with grilled chicken, served over a bed of rice and topped with a sweet and savory sauce.
instructions: 2. Season chicken breast with salt, pepper, and your favorite Japanese seasonings.
3. Grill chicken for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
4. Meanwhile, prepare sushi rice according to package instructions.
5. In a small saucepan, combine donburi sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, and rice vinegar. Bring to a simmer over medium heat.
6. In a large bowl, combine cooked sushi rice, donburi sauce, and sesame oil. Mix well to combine.
7. Slice grilled chicken into thin strips.
8. Assemble donburi by placing a scoop of rice onto a plate, followed by a few slices of chicken, and topped with green onions, sesame seeds, and grated daikon (if using).
10. Garnish with additional green onions and sesame seeds, if desired.
